purpose: Cover AC-2601-1 through AC-2601-7 via unit tests over the shipped application-forms-wizard blueprint.json contribution shape (19 contributions in the 5 REQ / 8 US / 3 TAC / 3 ADR groups), the applies-clean pass on a fresh init project, the pack-loader accepting the shipped pack file with every check id cross-checked against blueprint AC ids and appliesTo referencing BOTH tacIds and route, the sample-app fixture serving the four wizard surfaces honestly and both save-and-return transports on their query branches, the negative-run behaviour on the ?break=task-list-vocab ?break=no-summary ?break=no-retain and ?break=no-draft switches, the vocabulary-and-transport enumeration parity across README guide pack and docs/topics.md registry, and the README mechanism-reach gaps and CHANGELOG 1.0.0 entry.
title: application-forms-wizard v1.0.0 shelf shape, probe pack cross-check and sample-app fixture
